newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Not guilty plea in Brazil soap opera murder trial.
newsitem.headline: Not guilty plea in Brazil soap opera murder trial.

text.p: The ex-wife of a Brazilian soap opera star accused of murdering his screen lover pleaded not guilty on Wednesday.
Paula Thomaz, 23, was charged jointly with her former husband, male-stripper-turned-TV-star Guilherme de Padua, for the December 1992 murder of Padua's co-star Daniela Perez.
Thomaz told the jury she was not at the scene of the crime when the murder took place, but was out shopping at a mall.
She faces 12 to 30 years in prison if found guilty.
The murder of 22-year-old Perez, who was found dead on a Rio roadside with 16 stab wounds, shocked Brazilians.
A Rio state court in January sentenced Padua to 19 years in jail, of which he has already served four waiting trial.

Padua originally confessed to the crime, saying Perez had been hounding him to have sex with her, but later, after his divorce from Thomaz, the actor accused his ex-wife. During his trial, he said she murdered the actress in a fit of jealousy, stabbing her at least 15 times with a pair of scissors.
He said he had an affair with Perez because her mother, Gloria, was the script writer for the soap opera in which they were co-starring.

The case has become Brazil's equivalent to the O.J. Simpson trial in the United States. It has dragged on for five years, littered with interviews by the defendants from behind bars, conflicting testimony from limelight-seeking witnesses and angry calls for justice from the victim's family.

Millions of Brazilian soap opera fans have watched its twists and turns as closely as the soap opera, "De Corpo e Alma" (Of Body and Soul), in which Padua shot to fame as the brooding lover of sexy Yasmin, played by Perez.
